# Pianoman Egypt — Piano Services in Cairo

## About
Pianoman Egypt is Cairo's premier piano service provider, specialising in piano rental, home visit tuning, and full piano restoration. We serve clients across Egypt with professional piano care.

## Services

### Piano Rental
- Flexible rental plans for homes, studios, events, and schools
- Upright and grand pianos available
- Delivery and setup included
- Monthly and long-term rental options

### Home Visit & Tuning
- Professional piano tuning at your location anywhere in Cairo
- Regulation, voicing, and minor repairs included
- Recommended every 6–12 months
- Experienced tuners trained on all makes and models

### Piano Restoration
- Full piano restoration and rebuilding
- Services include: soundboard replacement, restringing, action rebuilding, tuning pin replacement, refinishing
- Before and after documentation provided
- Suitable for antique, heritage, and performance instruments

We serve all areas of Cairo and Greater Cairo, with home visits available across the city.
